The '''Protector StarSpeeder''' was a class of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The fighters had a top speed of 560 [[Kilometer/Legends|KM]][[Standard hour/Legends|H]] and were armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="Enemies for Life" />
